description: An HTML file containing embedded JavaScript that defines a 'Calculator' service class used for remote procedure calls, registers methods, and establishes a connection via ServiceManager.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending Service that provides 'add' and 'sub' methods for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an array of parameters and returns the sum as a Promise.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtracts the second parameter from the first and returns the difference as a Promise.
